name: smwgraphics-sexy-parodius-psx-underwater-palace-second-half
title: Sexy Parodius (PSX) - Underwater Palace (Second Half)
description:
This background is seen in stage 3A of the game. You'll need to reach area where you'll fight Otohime. I chose to rip the second part of the BG as the first one used more tiles. You can add wavy HDMA just like the original or FG HDMA.

Uses the second half of palette row 4.

No credit required.
